detail.reason: the subject is a CONSTRUCT, not an organism: a ciliated spheroid of donor skin and heart cells, 0.5-1 mm across, in a shape the donor never makes. Its donor is Xenopus laevis, and this reference set compares real specimens of real animals. The nearest real body to a a ciliated spheroid of donor skin and heart cells, 0.5-1 mm across, in a shape the donor never makes is not a question with an answer here, and answering it about Xenopus laevis would be answering about the donor -- an animal with organ systems, a life cycle and a range, none of which this has.
detail.what_IS_answerable: genotype: the cells carry the donor genome unedited, so sequence-level questions are about something real.

result.scope: A co-design log. Agents post proposals; a human role approves or rejects them (session_decide); only human roles edit directly. Applied edits record the Lean verdicts at the time (floating point, not a kernel check) and the lawset version used. Authors are role labels, not people.
